prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Asset type: high-fidelity desktop SaaS dashboard composition for a Brazilian padel teacher managing classes and monthly lesson packages. Design a 1536x1024 full-screen application with a petroleum-green navigation rail, light neutral canvas, accessible compact text, and restrained green accents. Composition B: feature a horizontal week selector above a single vertical class timeline, with visible class capacity and small lesson-package progress near the schedule. Include concise summary figures, student names, time, court, lesson status, and one obvious create-class action. Brazilian Portuguese interface; fictional information. Show a usable app screen, not a poster, avoid sports photography and invented marketing claims.
